text:
Seven Lives

To Mrs. María A. S. de Fontán


I have seven lives, I have seven lives.

Seven lives of gold;

lovely and florid.

Head cut off, head replaced:

My tree-spirit

sprouts again in the siesta.


Purple dragon of flowering claws,

seven lives I have, I have seven

lives.

Giants and dwarfs: cut off my heads,

they will grow stubborn as

the weeds.


I have seven lives, I have seven lives,

seven lives of gold lovely and

florid


that irons tire and swords notch,

yet one day they will be forever

felled.


The prince I await will dry

the seven flowering heads. Without

abracadabras,

the winged dragon will lose its lives

beneath the slender edge of

sweet words.

translation.title: Love
translation.editorial_note: The catalog title says Love, but the embedded source is Seven Lives, so the internal heading is preserved.
